2. Keep Quake #31 and both Soldier tokens home (the tokens are summoning sick anyway).
3. After combat, cast S.H.I.E.L.D. Spy Kit with a Plains ({W}), which triggers Quake to tap a target. One Plains is left over, so you can pay Equip {1} to put the Kit on Quake or Doombot. Equip is sorcery speed, so do it in main phase 2.

**Why:** The opponent has no flyers and no untapped mana, so Doombot gets 1 free damage with no risk. Quake attacking into a 2/2 and a 1/1 could be double-blocked: they deal 3 damage and kill it, and you would only trade it for two small tokens. The AI's Peggy has -3 power, so she can't hurt anything.

**Rule:** Take free damage, don't trade your engine.

**Confidence:** medium. A Quake attack is probably fine too, but the upside is small and the risk is real.

**Trap:** Attacking with Quake. A double block from the 2/2 (with Spy Kit) and the 1/1 kills it, and Quake is your best card for tempo with noncreature spells.

**Their turn:** They have 0 cards in hand, and all their lands untap. Their attackers are the 2/2 and 1/1 Soldiers, and Peggy deals no damage. Their Helicarrier needs 6 power to crew and they have none. Quake and two Soldier tokens at home block everything comfortably. They'll topdeck one card at most, and I can't see it.

**Assumptions:** The opponent's Helicarrier can't be crewed, since their creatures have 0 total power.

ANSWER: attack:25

1. Target Giant-Sized Flying Ant #64 with Quake's trigger (Strategic Intervention is still on the stack; no mana needed).
2. Strategic Intervention resolves. It costs {1}{W}, already paid by Plains #14 and Island #33.
3. Attack with Quake alone. Strategic Intervention gives it +1/+1, so it hits as a 4/4 for 4 damage. Its own attack trigger can tap "up to one" creature; no other target matters.
4. Keep Thriving Isle and both Plains untapped, so {W} for Helicarrier Strike is ready. Nothing else is cast.

**Why:** The trigger taps a creature or land. The Ant is the opponent's only untapped creature and the only possible blocker. The opponent has no untapped lands, so it can't flash in anything either. Tapping it lets Quake connect safely. Tapping any of my own permanents does nothing for me, and the opponent's other creatures and lands are already tapped.

**Rule:** Remove the only blocker.

**Confidence:** high

**Trap:** Tapping one of my own lands for no benefit, or targeting the already-tapped Doombot or Air Force, which does nothing. Tapping my own Quake would stop my attack.

**Their turn:** The opponent untaps with Air Force 2/1 flying, Doombot 1/1 flying and Ant 3/2 flying, 4 lands and 3 cards in hand. That is 6 damage in the air against my 13 life, and I have no flyers to block. Quake will be tapped. Hold {W} for Helicarrier Strike on an attacker: 2 damage kills any of the three (toughness 1, 1 and 2). I'd aim it at the Ant (3 power) or the Air Force.

ANSWER: target:64
